```yaml
name: Gitbook Docs Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Release version'
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  sync-gitbook:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Install Gitbook CLI
        run: npm install -g gitbook-cli

      - name: Configure Gitbook
        run: |
          echo "token: ${{ secrets.GITBOOK_TOKEN }}" > ~/.gitbookrc
          echo "spaceId: ${{ secrets.GITBOOK_SPACE_ID }}" >> ~/.gitbookrc

      - name: Create or update docs/v{major}.{minor} branch
        run: |
          major=$(echo ${{ github.ref }} | cut -d'.' -f2)
          minor=$(echo ${{ github.ref }} | cut -d'.' -f3)
          if [[ ${{ github.ref }} == *".0"* ]]; then
            git checkout -b docs/v$major.$minor
            git add .
            git commit -m "Update docs for v$major.$minor"
            git push origin docs/v$major.$minor --force
            gitbook build docs/gitbook/
            gitbook publish docs/gitbook/ https://api.gitbook.com/spaces/${{ secrets.GITBOOK_SPACE_ID }}/versions?token=${{ secrets.GITBOOK_TOKEN }}
          else
            git checkout docs/v$major.$minor || git checkout -b docs/v$major.$minor
            git pull origin docs/v$major.$minor
            git add .
            git commit -m "Sync docs for v$major.$minor"
            git push origin docs/v$major.$minor --force
          fi

  release:
    needs: sync-gitbook
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'tags'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Publish release
        id: publish_release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref }}
          release_name: ${{ github.ref }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
          body: |
            ## Release Notes

            - Updated documentation for v${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Sync Gitbook after release
        if: ${{ github.event.inputs.perform_release == 'true' }}
        run: |
          major=$(echo ${{ github.ref }} | cut -d'.' -f2)
          minor=$(echo ${{ github.ref }} | cut -d'.' -f3)
          git checkout docs/v$major.$minor
          git pull origin docs/v$major.$minor
          gitbook build docs/gitbook/
          gitbook publish docs/gitbook/ https://api.gitbook.com/spaces/${{ secrets.GITBOOK_SPACE_ID }}/versions?token=${{ secrets.GITBOOK_TOKEN }}
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file `.github/workflows/gitbook-release.yml` automates the process of creating and updating Gitbook docs branches and variants on release. It includes steps to configure Gitbook, create or update the `docs/v{major}.{minor}` branch, and optionally call the Gitbook API to create a new space variant for `x.y.0` releases. The workflow is triggered on pushes to release tags and can be manually invoked through the GitHub Actions interface.
